annotations.title: Check if chatbot voice can be used

description:
Check if chatbot voice can be used

A yes or no for the voice button of your chatbots: `available` is true when your account has a voice plan with minutes left or without a minute limit. It only reads and never buys an automatic top up; it returns false when the check fails. Use it before offering voice in a chatbot. For the figures use `list_usage_pools` (minutes per plan, `widgetMinutes` for the voice button) or `get_balance`.
name: get_voice_minutes_available
title: Check if chatbot voice can be used
